dataBase.description: Default base URL for relative `source` paths; overridden at build time by VITE_DATA_BASE.

threshold.description: Shared threshold friction velocity u*,th control.

tone.description: overall lightness of the basemap: the dune-name labels are pale with a dark halo on dark basemaps and dark brown with a light halo on light ones (default dark)

imagery.description: photographic imagery: the layer panel suggests lowering the colour layers' opacity when it is chosen

info.description: Content of the basemap's info (i) popover: definition, Source, Resolution, Coverage (optional), Licence, Link.

datasets.description: Wind-forcing datasets. Layer `source` / cell store paths containing '{dataset}' expand to the selected dataset's `prefix`; sources without it are dataset-independent.

prefix.description: Path prefix relative to dataBase, e.g. dune-atlas/v1

cellAuxStore.description: Single per-cell sidecar store (older registries); ignored when cellAuxStores is given.

cellAuxStores.description: Per-cell sidecar stores on the cells.zarr grid, merged in order (cells-aux.zarr, cells-aux-<name>.zarr); default ['{dataset}/cells-aux.zarr', '{dataset}/cells-aux-veg.zarr'].

info.description: How the panel, About and downloads describe the dataset (app cell/datasetinfo.ts).

nHours.description: samples in the record (hours for hourly data); the app takes the exact count from the cell store (series length)

landThreshold.description: land fraction (the dataset's land–sea mask or land-fraction field) above which a cell carries wind data

nonLandReason.description: why a cell outside the land mask has no statistics; empty: no land mask (every cell has data)

dunesRule.description: what 'dunes' means for a cell of this grid

fieldsFrom.description: map fields from the paper's data record or computed for the atlas

sourceTitle.description: bold title of its About item (default 'Wind histograms and sand-flux fields (<name> <resolution>)')

sourceHtml.description: About, Data sources: the dataset's item (HTML)

grid.description: cell-centre grid of the cell store (= its root attrs grid): row iy at lat0 + dlat * iy (north to south, dlat < 0), column ix at lon0 + dlon * ix. Cells may be non-square (|dlat| != dlon) and the rows need not reach the poles: there are no cells poleward of lat0 - dlat / 2. Used before the cell store is open and for the latitude coverage of the panel and search.

kind.description: what the dataset is, without its name, read after 'Name: ' in the Wind dataset ⓘ (e.g. 'free-running climate-model simulation')

note.description: a sentence about this dataset for the Wind dataset ⓘ (e.g. how it relates to another dataset)

optionLabel.description: entry text in the Wind dataset selector when 'name resolution' is too wide for the 360 px embed, e.g. 'MERRA-2 ½° × ⅝°'

landShort.description: land rule of the selector tooltip, e.g. 'land cells: land–sea mask fraction > 0' (datasets with a land mask)

series.description: datasets with per-sample series (Mars): the sampling and the long names of the time columns of the cell downloads

samplesPerSol.description: samples per sol (24: hourly, 12: every two Mars hours)

indexText.description: long name of the sample-index column (hour) of the downloads

solText.description: long name of the sol column of the downloads

credits.description: Citations and notices of the dataset (app cell/citation.ts).

sources.description: citation source ids cited for this dataset (the body's or citationSources), in order

dataSource.description: id of its wind-data citation source (listed in About for every dataset)

fieldsCitation.description: citation of the atlas-derived map fields (= pipeline fields.fields_citation)

mapNotice.description: short attribution line on the map and in About while the dataset is selected (e.g. the Copernicus statement)

notice.description: data notice written into downloads (e.g. the Copernicus notice)

citationSources.description: citation sources defined by this dataset

defaultDataset.description: id of the dataset selected by default

datasetLayers.description: Filled by the app's registry loader (not written by hand): per non-default dataset, the layer definitions that differ from the default dataset's, by layer id (from registry/earth/datasets/<id>/).

titleTex.description: Optional LaTeX title from source attrs

shortTitle.description: Optional row label in the layer panel, where the group heading gives the context (e.g. 'Mask' under 'Dune Fields'); `title` is used everywhere else (Active layers, exports, accessible names)

source.description: URL or path relative to dataBase

variable.description: Variable name inside a zarr store

thresholdAware.description: Layer has the shared threshold dimension; slider drives its selector.

windDerived.description: Computed from the wind data ('Dunes only' restricts it to the dataset's dune cells). Default: true for zarr-field layers with thresholdAware, false otherwise (app/src/core/map/dunemask.ts).

attribution.description: Structured source statement for third-party data shown by the app (all optional strings).

queryable.description: Show value in cell panel on click

transform.description: rad-to-bearing: math angle (CCW from E, toward) to compass bearing 0-360; rad-to-axis: unsigned axis 0-180

colormap.description: Default named colormap from app/src/core/generated/colormaps.json (users can change it in the panel)

magnitudeVar.description: Directional fields: variable whose value scales arrow length/opacity in 'arrows' mode (e.g. rdpa -> rdpm); also the default validity mask (see maskVar).

maskVar.description: Directional fields: variable that must be > 0 (and finite) for the direction to be shown in every render mode (colour map, arrows, streamlines); cells where it is <= 0 or NaN are treated as no data. Defaults to magnitudeVar (rdpa -> rdpm, at/ab -> qacb, ae/ao -> qace).

ticks.description: Legend tick values (display units) replacing the default ticks (e.g. class limits); the clim ends are always shown.

legendNote.description: Short note shown under the legend (e.g. saturation of the top value, regions without data).

topLabel.description: Legend label of the upper clim end (e.g. '≥ 6.55' when the top value is saturated).

style.description: MapLibre paint/layout overrides for vector layers

invertSource.description: Vector tiles of the complement (e.g. land WITHOUT dunes) for the panel's 'invert' toggle; URL or path relative to dataBase (pmtiles-vector).
